mapper.select: select count(1) as cnt from ${msg_table} where sms_st = '0' and reg_snd_dttm is null and msg_gb = '${msg_type}' limit 1
mapper.update: update ${msg_table} set sms_st = '9' ,reg_snd_dttm = '${group_no}' where cmp_msg_id in (select r.cmp_msg_id from ${msg_table} r where sms_st = '0' and reg_snd_dttm is null and msg_gb = '${msg_type}' limit ${send_msg_limit})
update ${msg_table} set sms_st = 'Y', cmp_snd_dttm = to_char(now(), 'yyyymmddhh24miss') where sms_st = '9' and reg_snd_dttm = '${group_no}' and msg_gb = '${msg_type}'
update ${msg_table} set sms_st = '0', reg_snd_dttm = null where sms_st = '9' and reg_snd_dttm = '${group_no}' and msg_gb = '${msg_type}'
mapper.select: select cmp_msg_id as msg_seq ,'AT' as messagetype ,snd_msg as msg_txt ,snd_msg as sms_txt ,(case when rcv_phn_id like '82%' then rcv_phn_id when rcv_phn_id like '010%' then '82' || substr(rcv_phn_id, 2, 15) else '82' || substr(rcv_phn_id, 2, 15) end) as call_to ,COALESCE(callback, snd_phn_id) as call_from ,resend_gb as msgtype ,subject as msg_txt_title ,'D' as pcom ,'N' as crypto ,to_char(now(), 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as curr_date ,COALESCE(snd_dttm, '00000000000000') as snd_dttm ,btn_1 ,btn_2 ,btn_3 ,btn_4 ,btn_5 ,template_cd ,profile_key from ${msg_table} where sms_st = '9' and msg_gb = '${msg_type}' and reg_snd_dttm = '${group_no}'
mapper.insert: update ${msg_table} set sms_st = '${sms_st}' ,rslt_val = '${rslt_val}' ,cmp_rcv_dttm = '${cmp_rcv_dttm}' ,rcv_mno_cd = '${rcv_mno_cd}' ,reg_rcv_dttm = to_char(now(), 'yyyymmddhh24miss') ,kmsg_rslt = '${kmsg_rslt}' where cmp_msg_id = '${cmp_msg_id}'
mapper.select: select count(1) as cnt from alive_monitoring
mapper.insert: insert into alive_monitoring(role, updated_date, status) values('${role}', now()::timestamp, 'MS')
mapper.select: select count(1) as cnt from alive_monitoring where updated_date::timestamp > (now() + '-15 second') and upper(role) = 'MASTER'
